primary_risk.statement: Approving vendor sandbox access to redacted C3 replay traces creates exposure if privacy/security controls fail or audit logging is incomplete.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval - the only policy-compliant path that meets operational needs.
Sanitized sample bundle is policy-safe but provides less value than P2 when P2 is available.
